findings.message: runBlocking in onCreate blocks the main thread until the session refresh completes, which can freeze the app or trigger an ANR. Launch the refresh in lifecycleScope instead.
prefetch() launches in GlobalScope, so the work is never cancelled and outlives its caller. Make prefetch() a suspend function or take a CoroutineScope.
current() returns null when nobody is signed in, so !! throws a NullPointerException inside the coroutine. Return early when there is no session.
This change removes the warmUp() call from init, and nothing else calls warmUp(). cachedUser therefore stays null, and requireUser() always throws IllegalStateException when refresh() runs.

preExisting.message: displayName() throws a NullPointerException when no name has been stored.
warmUp() launches in GlobalScope, so the work is never cancelled.
